title: Dust Devil
wikitext:
'''Dust Devils''' are [[elemental]] monsters that roam the grasslands of [[Westfall]].  Dust Devils are typically around level 18, and they can be extremely dangerous to [[player]]s who have only recently "graduated" from [[Elwynn Forest]].

Characteristics:
* Dust Devils have a whirlwind attack that can [[root]] opponents.
* Like most elementals, Dust Devils are immune to [[Schools_of_Magic#Nature|Nature]] damage, including a [[Hunter|Hunter's]] [[Serpent Sting]] ability.

[[Category:Air_Elemental]]
